mission: Test whether forcing explicit competing causal variants improves final diagnosis and discriminating-test selection on blind historical Ordivon incidents under the same per-turn Provider budget.
questionOrHypothesis: Does explicit variation before selection improve causal diagnosis, or can a strong model select as well from one direct pass?
evidenceSelection: Six historical incidents with later owner-established causes. Provider-visible packets stop before final resolution and expose only bounded symptoms, candidate cause classes and candidate discriminating tests. Oracle cause/test IDs remain evaluator-only.
strongBaseline: SINGLE treatment: select one cause and one discriminating test directly from the same packet/options.
minimalCandidateOrNoChange: VARIATION treatment: explicitly retain four distinct plausible causes, then select one final cause and one test. No new memory, graph or multi-agent substrate.
independentOracle: Frozen later owner evidence mapped to exact cause ID plus one or more accepted discriminating test IDs.
developmentSplit: Three cases: Web Chromium, Finance OKX, Host optional MCP dependency.
holdoutSplit: Three cases: P4 Provider output budget, P4 false acceptance gate, Runtime connector publication gap.
invalidityConditions: oracle text appears in Provider-visible packet
case/options change after first live call
structured result schema differs by treatment
one treatment gets a larger max output/token/run budget
invalid Provider result is scored as a semantic miss rather than transport/format invalidity
authorityBoundary: Computing research only; historical owner evidence is read-only and no owner source/effect is invoked.
budget: DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro; two predeclared replicas per model/treatment/case; 6 cases x 2 treatments x 2 models x 2 replicas = 48 logical trials. Same max_output_tokens=700 and Harness no-tool budget per trial.
stopRule: Stop after all 48 logical slots either yield valid structured decisions or retain terminal Provider invalidity. Do not add cases or replicas based on observed result.
deletionOrNoChangeOutcome: If VARIATION does not improve final diagnosis/test correctness enough to offset token/call cost, downgrade H-VARIATION and do not build variation infrastructure. Coverage-only gains are insufficient.
rollbackRule: Research-only files and temporary Harness state; no owner mutations.
publicationBoundary: F4 can update Computing PAL hypotheses only. It cannot promote multi-agent/branching/search infrastructure.
